title: Loading: append, upsert, and the slowly changing dimension

videos.script: Loading is the step that writes into a table that already holds something. Last year's sales. Where a customer lived in January. {{holds}} Ana appends a day of sales, and then a scheduler retries and appends it again. Every line is now in the table twice. {{append}} So she replaces the day instead: delete it and insert it, in one transaction. Run it twice and nothing changes. {{replace}} Books are overwritten when a publisher changes a price. One book, one update, the rest untouched. {{upsert}} Customers are different. On the fifteenth, customer three one four five moves to Rio. The São Paulo row is closed, and a Rio row is opened. {{scd}} A sale from the eleventh stays in São Paulo for ever. {{sale}} And while all this happens, people are reading. One statement locks them out. Another lets them see yesterday. {{readers}}
